description:
Professional lighting and sensor planning

Standard-compliant planning and simulation of artificial light, daylight and sensors in real time. For beginners and professionals in lighting planning. Intuitive operation, simple and fast display of the calculation values.
ADDED

IFC-Import/Export: Displaying additional details on the progress of the import process.
Automatic installation of the .NET 10 Runtime if it is not present.
UGR table values in the result overview can now be rounded to a custom number of decimal places based on glare rounding properties.

FIXED

IFC-Import/Export: Cancelling the function no longer results in an error message.
IFC-Import/Export: Invalid geometry is skipped during import and does not result in the process being terminated.
IFC-Import/Export: Improved calculation of window and door positions where no usable geometry is available.
Resolved an issue in escape route calculations.
Resolved a crash that could occur during the triangulation of measuring surfaces.
Resolved an issue that caused FBX texture and material properties to conflict, ensuring their correct application.
The alignment arrow is also displayed when the luminaires are stacked on top of each other.
